lead_deck: Patara Nomad Migration event took place
lead_body: The 23rd Lycian Waterway Walk and Patara Nomad Migration event were held in Kaş. This event showcases the tourism and cultural richness of the Kaş and Kalkan region. The beauty of the Lycian Waterway and the historical importance of Patara were highlighted at the event.
